items.title: Versioned execution contracts and native illumos feasibility harness
items.scope: Own crates/akh-session-types and an isolated qualification harness. Define operation, target, generation, environment-lock, result/error and receipt contracts. Qualify pinned TypeScript checker/transpiler with curated declarations, JS engine (QuickJS candidate), WASM component runtime, ZIP reader and Rust/TypeScript grammar execution on oibuild. Establish enforceable shell-free native descendants; record any required ports.
items.accept: Deliver actual probe/harness code, version locks and native evidence, not only a recommendation. Tests must exercise async host calls, interruption, binary/UTF-8 IO, component imports and interpreter recovery. Record exact source SHA, host/toolchain and exit codes. If any fixed requirement is infeasible, retain a typed blocker; do not weaken it. Do not expose probe stubs as production APIs.

items.title: akhpack v1 format, verified ZIP reader/writer and packed VFS
items.scope: Own proposed crates/akhpack and crates/akh-vfs, with adapters to crates/akh-session-services/src/workspace.rs and src/fs. Specify canonical manifest/inventory and path rules, concrete resource limits, exact dependency digests, signature/trust policy and byte-oriented mount APIs. Implement reproducible package production, verification and immutable packed reads with separate writable overlays.
items.accept: Read the same packed fixture on macOS and native illumos without an extracted package tree. Test traversal, duplicate/case/Unicode collisions, symlinks, forged headers/digests, overlapping entries, ZIP bombs, limits and undeclared payloads. Hash verification precedes activation; installing never runs code or grants authority. Preserve descriptor-relative confinement and revision checks.

items.title: No-any TypeScript admission and bounded executor REPL workers
items.scope: Own proposed crates/akh-repl and isolated worker integration in akhexecd. Supply curated noLib declarations, strict checking plus semantic rejection of explicit/inferred/transitive any, checked cell compilation, typed host-call interface, bounded streams and output, CPU/memory deadlines and cancellation. No Node/DOM/std/os/process/eval/function-constructor bypass.
items.accept: Negative tests cover deep/generic/imported any, unchecked JS, suppression directives, assertion laundering and unchecked decode boundaries. Positive tests cover narrowed unknown and intent-specific generics. Prove cancellation of JS/WASM/native parsing work and worker crash containment. Types never substitute for runtime capability checks. Native oibuild worker and checker tests are required.

items.title: On-demand package activation, WIT bridge and generated typed imports
items.scope: Own package activation, REPL module loading and src/agent/wasm_runtime.rs / wit interfaces. Implement exact-digest resolve/verify/activate, contract-derived TS declarations and runtime codecs, verified WIT exports/imports, bounded discovery and selected documentation. Update the next cell's type environment atomically while running cells retain their lock.
items.accept: Install and invoke a real WASM parser from a packed akhpack on illumos. Test WIT mismatch, unauthorized host imports, forged declarations, cycles, interrupted/concurrent installs and failed activation. Old lock stays usable on failure. No package catalog flood in model context, no native/engine bytecode distribution and no capability escalation by installation.

items.title: Persistent sandbox environments, explicit switching and receipt recovery
items.scope: Own executor/sandbox/shared session types and caller integration. Bind each cell/effect to principal, environment, sandbox, host, generation and package lock; provide explicit switching and schema-versioned durable values. Separate live heap from durable data and execution evidence. Add bounded incremental output cursors and explicit artifact transfer.
items.accept: Prove A→B→A retains state without grant/secret leakage; an in-flight operation never changes target. Restart restores durable data/definitions, invalidates live handles and does not replay effects. Test stale generations, concurrent writes, schema migration/rollback, effect-completed-before-response crashes and unknown outcomes. Preserve ADR 113 akhomed authority for full Akh turns.

items.title: Sandbox-local Shen Rust/TypeScript syntax editing and revision transactions
items.scope: Own crates/shend, sandbox worker and VFS edit adapter. Add Rust/TypeScript syntax snapshots, typed node queries and source edits, preview, expected-revision commit, reparse and diagnostics. Preserve CST trivia/untouched bytes; expose semantic-refactor capability only where resolution coverage is proven. Maintain central code KG as derived read model.
items.accept: Edit a Rust function and a typed parser/handler, preserving comments and unrelated source. Test stale node/parser/content revisions, competing writers, incomplete rename resolution, syntax failures and crashes across multi-file publication. VFS snapshots may publish atomically; do not claim cross-file host rename atomicity. Unsupported languages receive explicit document operations, never shell fallback.

items.title: Opaque credential capabilities, bounded inference and Akh-admitted reactions
items.scope: Own host capability broker, inference client and akhomed trigger/reactor integration; akheventd remains thin ingress under ADR 113. Implement opaque credential handles, scoped sinks and protected transforms, typed inference requests/results/budgets, pinned handler registrations, event deduplication/backpressure and receipt recovery. Reuse ADR 114 Structural/Shadow decision seam.
items.accept: Synthetic credential tests cover printing/interpolation/JSON/errors/artifacts/guest memory, redirects, cross-host reuse and echoing endpoints. No plaintext credential enters arbitrary TS/WASM. Prove duplicate/recursive event and exhausted-budget behavior. Learned classifier outputs remain shadow data and cannot select live actions until separately qualified; use structural decisions for live trigger acceptance. Include real-model inference smoke evidence separately from quality or dispatch-readiness claims.

items.title: Typed repository, diagnostics/build and host-control operations without shells
items.scope: Own repository bootstrap/publication/snapshot services, typed diagnostics/build adapters and host controls. Replace shell use cases with intent-specific operations through akhsbxd/akhexecd for every caller. No arbitrary command, executable path, argv, hooks or scripts. Fixed native adapters must constrain their descendants; source AST edits alone do not establish build compatibility.
items.accept: Prove representative source→edit→diagnostics/test and repository workflows on oibuild without any shell descendant of the system under test. Test Git hooks/aliases, shell-spawning build scripts, provider helpers and unauthorized host operations. Unsupported toolchains fail visibly, not through fallback. Use isolated test fixtures; no production deployment or main-gate bypass.

items.title: Remove all shell/argv surfaces and migrate full Akh and delegated providers
items.scope: Own executor/broker, src/agent shell tools, src/backend, provider adapters/helper launchers and test fixtures. Inventory and remove command strings, generic argv, remote-shell routes, provider built-ins and MCP tools that reintroduce arbitrary shell execution. Replace tests with purpose-built native helpers. Retain full Akh cognition, loops and full capability registry per ADR 113.
items.accept: Attempt legacy operations through every registered caller/transport and prove no process is created. A hidden endpoint or provider-local bypass fails conformance. Full Akh and supported native providers use the typed environment; incompatible adapters are explicitly unsupported. No reduced Akh profile, disabling cognition, silent capability deletion or compatibility flag restoring shell execution. Run regression and concurrent admission tests.

items.title: Integrated oibuild release gate and reproducible end-to-end evidence
items.scope: Own integration fixtures and native evidence harness. Execute the plan's complete scenario: packed install, typed parser/filter/state, Rust/TS edit/diagnostics, opaque credential fixture, structural live event + shadow inference, sandbox/host switching, restart reconciliation and legacy-shell rejection. Cover full Akh and delegated supported providers.
items.accept: Deliver harness code plus exact-candidate native illumos results and focused negative/recovery matrix. Report archive/lock digests, source SHA, host/toolchain, receipts, bounded output, process-tree observations and remaining limits. No Linux-only or hello-world substitute, no learned routing activation, no duplicate effects. This gate is test evidence; production deployment remains separately authorized and main-only with embedded short SHA.
